products.subtitle: Tactile Heritage: Corduroy Takes the Lead

trendReference.title: Tactile Heritage: Corduroy Takes the Lead
trendReference.reasonEN: A loose womenswear silhouette reworks workwear trousers in eight-wale cotton corduroy. Black remains versatile while tactile ribs and generous leg volume add a distinct winter update for Mark’s.

materials.name: Eight-Wale Everyday Corduroy
materials.hand: Eight-wale cotton Coventry corduroy; described by the brand as midweight.
materials.structure: Eight-wale cotton Coventry corduroy; described by the brand as midweight.
materials.composition: Upper material: 100% cotton. Pocket lining: 65% polyester, 35% cotton.
materials.care: Hang to dry; iron up to 200°C; machine wash up to 40°C; tumble dry up to 60°C.

trendBasis.title: Tactile Heritage: Corduroy Takes the Lead
trendBasis.reason: Keeps the source’s workwear familiarity and the report’s tactile heritage. The loose women’s shape gains interest from rib texture rather than added decoration.

materials.visualBrief: Washed-black eight-wale corduroy swatch with broad soft ribs, subtle pile shading and a folded edge; no distressed damage.
materials.visualNote: Digital colour and pattern direction. Physical fabric approval required.

materials.name: Brushed Cavalry Twill
materials.hand: Target a dry, softly brushed surface with visible diagonal relief.
materials.structure: Steep double-diagonal cavalry-twill weave with a light face brushing; proposed as a non-corduroy workwear alternative.

trendBasis.title: Tactile Heritage: Corduroy Takes the Lead
trendBasis.reason: Extends tactile heritage through a diagonal woven texture. It retains an uncomplicated loose trouser suitable for everyday workwear-inspired dressing.

materials.visualBrief: Deep espresso cavalry-twill swatch showing a steep fine double diagonal, lightly brushed face and low sheen; no corduroy ribs.
materials.visualNote: Digital colour and pattern direction. Physical fabric approval required.

materials.name: Tonal Micro-Grid Printed Twill
materials.hand: Target a matte, lightly peached face with barely visible tonal pattern.
materials.structure: Fine 2/2 twill with a small printed grid; a printed alternative, not a yarn-dyed check or a claimed source-garment fabric.

trendBasis.title: Texture in Harmony: Tonal Everyday Dressing
trendBasis.reason: A muted grid is our interpretation of tonal texture and self-expression. It adds variety to familiar workwear proportions while remaining easy to coordinate.

materials.visualBrief: Charcoal-ground textile with a fine near-black micro-grid, about 4-6 mm as a design target, low contrast and a lightly peached surface; no logos.
materials.visualNote: Digital colour and pattern direction. Physical fabric approval required.
